Author: dajoey
Name: LazyCrucible
Description: For the Beastmaster duty Crucible of the Unbroken. Fills the ten-familiar run roster at the Bentbranch Meadows entry menu and the three Battlehorn slots before every fight with the familiars that answer that fight's mechanics: elemental weakness, interrupts, dispels, cleanses and crowd control, skipping knocked-out familiars and benching badly hurt ones. Picks are announced in chat. Every automation has its own toggle and manual edits always win. Includes the beast-pick advisor for every board and a read-only recorder that writes each Crucible screen to the Dalamud log. Use /lazycrucible to open.
Punchline: Crucible of the Unbroken familiar picks, filled in for every fight
Changelog:
v0.1.9.23 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- The window was polished for the real in-game font and scale: text no longer clips or sits against card borders, in both windows.
- The current battle in the advisor battles list is shown in the accent colour with a "current" label instead of a raw marker, and "Show in the loadout rail" is a rounded accent-tinted row like the other lists.
- The close button is a drawn cross in a rounded box with an accent hover state and a "Close" tooltip that sits beneath the button.
- The Idle, Empty and Needs setup pills read clearly on the dark pill, the Home page no longer shows a one-item navigation band, and stat cards without a real ratio no longer draw an empty progress track.
- Both windows keep a minimum height so the header, body and footer always fit.

v0.1.9.22 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- LazyCrucible now uses the approved custom shell with pink navigation and track toggles, responsive cards, aligned battle-plan and guide columns, and persistent footer actions.
- Main and guide windows now open at 1280×840 on first use, without the native title bar and with a drawn close button.

v0.1.9.21 (2026-11-15) [testing]

- Main-window guide pages follow the actual focused fight and incoming casts, with persistent footer actions and improved narrow-window wrapping.

v0.1.9.20 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- LazyCrucible's settings and fight guide use a searchable, card-based layout with live status, clearer requirements, and grouped controls.
- Battlehorn picks, fight mechanics, and recent choices are easier to scan at large and small window sizes.

v0.1.9.19 (2026-11-15) [testing]
